messages.subject: Clean Energy & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Barnes,

Navitas Resourcing Group's focus on clean power, renewable energy and critical infrastructure makes this a relevant introduction for senior leadership mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with direct exposure to utility-scale solar, battery storage and climate-resilience investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where clean-energy growth, institutional engagement, sustainability performance and responsible development must work together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
